package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (repository *Repository) SetRunRunning(ctx context.Context, runID string, at time.Time) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(runID) || at.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	var raw []byte
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT run.payload FROM practice_validation_runs AS run
JOIN practice_submissions AS submission ON submission.id=run.submission_id AND submission.current_run_id=run.id
JOIN practice_task_instances AS instance ON instance.id=run.task_instance_id AND instance.current_submission_id=submission.id
WHERE run.id=$1 AND run.status='PENDING' AND submission.status='VALIDATING' AND instance.status='VALIDATING'
FOR UPDATE OF run`, runID).Scan(&raw)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			var exists bool
			if checkErr := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM practice_validation_runs WHERE id=$1)`, runID).Scan(&exists); checkErr != nil {
				return checkErr
			}
			if !exists {
				return domain.ErrNotFound
			}
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return err
	}
	var run domain.ValidationRun
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &run); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("decode persisted ValidationRun: %w", err)
	}
	started := at.UTC()
	run.Status = domain.ValidationRunRunning
	run.StartedAt = &started
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(run)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_validation_runs AS run SET status='RUNNING',started_at=$2,payload=$3::jsonb,updated_at=$2
FROM practice_submissions AS submission,practice_task_instances AS instance
WHERE run.id=$1 AND run.status='PENDING' AND submission.id=run.submission_id AND submission.current_run_id=run.id AND submission.status='VALIDATING'
AND instance.id=run.task_instance_id AND instance.current_submission_id=submission.id AND instance.status='VALIDATING'`, runID, started, encoded)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	return translateError(tx.Commit())
}

func (repository *Repository) GetValidationContextByRunID(ctx context.Context, runID string) (domain.TaskInstance, domain.Submission, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(runID) {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	var taskInstanceID, submissionID string
	err := repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT task_instance_id,submission_id FROM practice_validation_runs WHERE id=$1`, runID).Scan(&taskInstanceID, &submissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, translateError(err)
	}
	instance, err := repository.GetInstanceByID(ctx, taskInstanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	submission, err := repository.GetSubmission(ctx, taskInstanceID, submissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	return instance, submission, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) CompleteValidation(ctx context.Context, submission domain.Submission, run domain.ValidationRun, instance domain.TaskInstance) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateTerminalRun(run); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	currentInstance, err := instanceForUpdate(ctx, tx, instance.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	currentSubmission, currentRunID, err := submissionForUpdate(ctx, tx, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if currentRunID == run.ID && len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns) > 0 {
		storedCurrent := currentSubmission.ValidationRuns[len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns)-1]
		if storedCurrent.Status == run.Status {
			candidateInstance := instance
			candidateInstance.Version = currentInstance.Version
			candidateSubmission := submission
			candidateSubmission.ValidationRuns = currentSubmission.ValidationRuns
			if currentInstance.CurrentSubmissionID == submission.ID && currentInstance.Status == instance.Status &&
				currentSubmission.Status == submission.Status && equalJSON(mustJSON(storedCurrent), mustJSON(run)) &&
				sameInstance(currentInstance, candidateInstance) && sameSubmission(currentSubmission, candidateSubmission) {
				return tx.Commit()
			}
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	if currentRunID != run.ID || currentInstance.CurrentSubmissionID != submission.ID || currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceValidating ||
		!sameSubmissionBinding(currentSubmission, submission) || !validTerminalTransition(submission, run, instance) ||
		!sameCompletionBinding(currentInstance, instance) || !validProgressProjection(instance) ||
		submission.Scope == "FINAL" && run.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass && instance.FinalSubmissionID != submission.ID {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	var storedRun domain.ValidationRun
	var currentRunRaw []byte
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_validation_runs WHERE submission_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') FOR UPDATE`, submission.ID, run.ID).Scan(&currentRunRaw)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(currentRunRaw, &storedRun); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("decode persisted ValidationRun: %w", err)
	}
	if storedRun.ID != run.ID || storedRun.StartedAt != nil && (run.StartedAt == nil || !storedRun.StartedAt.Equal(*run.StartedAt)) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	encodedRun, err := json.Marshal(run)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_validation_runs SET status=$2,outcome=$3,error_classification=$4,started_at=$5,finished_at=$6,payload=$7::jsonb,updated_at=$8
WHERE id=$1 AND submission_id=$9 AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')`, run.ID, run.Status, nullableString(string(run.Outcome)),
		nullableString(run.ErrorClassification), nullableTime(run.StartedAt), nullableTime(run.FinishedAt), encodedRun, time.Now().UTC(), submission.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	currentSubmission.Status = submission.Status
	currentSubmission.ValidationRuns = append(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns, run)
	currentSubmission.CompletedAt = submission.CompletedAt
	currentSubmission.UpdatedAt = submission.UpdatedAt
	currentSubmission.HumanReview = submission.HumanReview
	currentSubmissionRaw, err := marshalSubmission(currentSubmission)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_submissions SET status=$2,payload=$3::jsonb,updated_at=$4,completed_at=$5
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND id=$6 AND current_run_id=$7`, currentSubmission.TaskInstanceID, currentSubmission.Status,
		currentSubmissionRaw, currentSubmission.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(currentSubmission.CompletedAt), currentSubmission.ID, run.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	instance.Version = currentInstance.Version + 1
	instanceRaw, err := marshalInstance(instance)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_task_instances SET status=$2,current_submission_id=$3,final_submission_id=$4,
version=$5,payload=$6::jsonb,updated_at=$7,completed_at=$8 WHERE id=$1 AND version=$9`, instance.ID,
		instance.Status, nullableUUID(instance.CurrentSubmissionID), nullableUUID(instance.FinalSubmissionID), instance.Version,
		instanceRaw, instance.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(instance.CompletedAt), currentInstance.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	return translateError(tx.Commit())
}

func validateTerminalRun(run domain.ValidationRun) error {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(run.ID) || run.StartedAt == nil || run.StartedAt.IsZero() || run.FinishedAt == nil || run.FinishedAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	switch run.Status {
	case domain.ValidationRunPassed:
		if run.Outcome != domain.OutcomePass {
			return domain.ErrInvalid
		}
	case domain.ValidationRunFailed:
		if run.Outcome != domain.OutcomeFail {
			return domain.ErrInvalid
		}
	case domain.ValidationRunError:
		if run.Outcome != domain.OutcomeError || run.ErrorClassification == "" {
			return domain.ErrInvalid
		}
	default:
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

func validTerminalTransition(submission domain.Submission, run domain.ValidationRun, instance domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	switch run.Outcome {
	case domain.OutcomeError:
		return submission.Status == domain.SubmissionValidating && instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceValidating
	case domain.OutcomeFail:
		return submission.Status == domain.SubmissionFailed && instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
	case domain.OutcomePass:
		if submission.Status == domain.SubmissionReviewRequired {
			return submission.Scope == "FINAL" && submission.RequiresHumanReview && instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInReview
		}
		if submission.Status == domain.SubmissionPassed && submission.Scope == "MILESTONE" {
			return instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
		}
		if submission.Status == domain.SubmissionPassed && submission.Scope == "FINAL" && !submission.RequiresHumanReview {
			return instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing || instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCompleted
		}
	}
	return false
}

func sameSubmissionBinding(left, right domain.Submission) bool {
	return left.ID == right.ID && left.TaskInstanceID == right.TaskInstanceID && left.StudentID == right.StudentID &&
		left.Scope == right.Scope && left.MilestoneID == right.MilestoneID && left.Snapshot == right.Snapshot &&
		left.WorkspaceDigest == right.WorkspaceDigest && left.RevisionDigest == right.RevisionDigest &&
		left.ValidationContractDigest == right.ValidationContractDigest &&
		equalJSON(left.ValidationSpecification, right.ValidationSpecification) &&
		left.RequiresHumanReview == right.RequiresHumanReview && left.IdempotencyKey == right.IdempotencyKey && left.CommandDigest == right.CommandDigest
}

func sameSubmission(left, right domain.Submission) bool {
	leftBytes, leftErr := marshalSubmission(left)
	rightBytes, rightErr := marshalSubmission(right)
	return canonicalEqual(leftBytes, rightBytes, leftErr, rightErr)
}

func submissionForUpdate(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, taskInstanceID, submissionID string) (domain.Submission, string, error) {
	var raw []byte
	var currentRunID string
	err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload,current_run_id FROM practice_submissions WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND id=$2 FOR UPDATE`, taskInstanceID, submissionID).Scan(&raw, &currentRunID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, "", translateError(err)
	}
	submission, err := unmarshalSubmission(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, "", fmt.Errorf("decode persisted Submission: %w", err)
	}
	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_validation_runs WHERE submission_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal`, submissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, "", err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	submission.ValidationRuns = make([]domain.ValidationRun, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var runRaw []byte
		var run domain.ValidationRun
		if err := rows.Scan(&runRaw); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, "", err
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(runRaw, &run); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, "", fmt.Errorf("decode persisted ValidationRun: %w", err)
		}
		submission.ValidationRuns = append(submission.ValidationRuns, run)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, "", err
	}
	return submission, currentRunID, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) CreateValidationRetry(ctx context.Context, submission domain.Submission, run domain.ValidationRun) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if run.Status != domain.ValidationRunPending || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(run.ID) || len(submission.ValidationRuns) < 2 || submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1].ID != run.ID {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	instance, err := instanceForUpdate(ctx, tx, submission.TaskInstanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, currentRunID, err := submissionForUpdate(ctx, tx, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if current.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating || instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceValidating || instance.CurrentSubmissionID != submission.ID ||
		currentRunID == run.ID || len(current.ValidationRuns) == 0 || currentRunID != current.ValidationRuns[len(current.ValidationRuns)-1].ID ||
		current.ValidationRuns[len(current.ValidationRuns)-1].Status != domain.ValidationRunError ||
		!sameSubmissionBinding(current, submission) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	var oldRun domain.ValidationRun
	if err := json.Unmarshal(mustJSON(current.ValidationRuns[len(current.ValidationRuns)-1]), &oldRun); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if oldRun.Outcome != domain.OutcomeError || !validSnapshotRef(submission.Snapshot) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	encodedRun, err := json.Marshal(run)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var ordinal int64
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal),0)+1 FROM practice_validation_runs WHERE submission_id=$1`, submission.ID).Scan(&ordinal); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_validation_runs(id,task_instance_id,submission_id,ordinal,status,payload,created_at,updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'PENDING',$5::jsonb,$6,$6)`, run.ID, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID, ordinal, encodedRun, time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	currentRunID = run.ID
	current.ValidationRuns = append(current.ValidationRuns, run)
	current.UpdatedAt = submission.UpdatedAt
	encodedSubmission, err := marshalSubmission(current)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_submissions SET current_run_id=$3,payload=$4::jsonb,updated_at=$5
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND id=$2`, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID, currentRunID, encodedSubmission, current.UpdatedAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	return translateError(tx.Commit())
}

func (repository *Repository) SaveReview(ctx context.Context, submission domain.Submission, instance domain.TaskInstance, reviewerID, decision string) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if submission.HumanReview == nil || submission.HumanReview.ReviewerID != reviewerID || submission.HumanReview.Decision != decision ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(reviewerID) || submission.HumanReview.Decision != "CHANGES_REQUESTED" {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	currentInstance, err := instanceForUpdate(ctx, tx, instance.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, currentRunID, err := submissionForUpdate(ctx, tx, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if currentRunID != lastRunID(current) || !sameSubmissionBinding(current, submission) || current.Status != domain.SubmissionReviewRequired ||
		currentInstance.CurrentSubmissionID != current.ID || currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInReview ||
		submission.Scope != "FINAL" || submission.Status != domain.SubmissionChangesRequested || instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if submission.HumanReview.Decision == "CHANGES_REQUESTED" && !sameCompletionBinding(currentInstance, instance) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	receipt := *submission.HumanReview
	if receipt.ReviewedAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	encodedReceipt, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var oldRaw []byte
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_review_events WHERE submission_id=$1`, submission.ID).Scan(&oldRaw)
	if err == nil {
		if equalJSON(oldRaw, encodedReceipt) {
			return tx.Commit()
		}
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_review_events(submission_id,task_instance_id,reviewer_id,decision,feedback,reviewed_at,payload)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb)`, submission.ID, submission.TaskInstanceID, reviewerID, receipt.Decision, receipt.Feedback, receipt.ReviewedAt.UTC(), encodedReceipt)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	current.HumanReview = &receipt
	if receipt.Decision == "CHANGES_REQUESTED" {
		current.Status = domain.SubmissionChangesRequested
		current.UpdatedAt = submission.UpdatedAt
		instance.Version = currentInstance.Version + 1
		instanceRaw, err := marshalInstance(instance)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		currentRaw, err := marshalSubmission(current)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_submissions SET status=$2,payload=$3::jsonb,updated_at=$4
WHERE id=$1`, submission.ID, current.Status, currentRaw, current.UpdatedAt.UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_task_instances SET status=$2,version=$3,payload=$4::jsonb,updated_at=$5
WHERE id=$1 AND version=$6`, instance.ID, instance.Status, instance.Version, instanceRaw, instance.UpdatedAt.UTC(), currentInstance.Version)
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
	} else {
		current.UpdatedAt = submission.UpdatedAt
		currentRaw, err := marshalSubmission(current)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_submissions SET payload=$2::jsonb,updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1`, submission.ID, currentRaw, current.UpdatedAt.UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
	}
	return translateError(tx.Commit())
}

func lastRunID(submission domain.Submission) string {
	if len(submission.ValidationRuns) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1].ID
}

// GetAssistance scopes durable replay to the persisted instance owner. It never
// derives authorization from a receipt supplied by the caller.
func (repository *Repository) GetAssistance(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, usageID string) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, string, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", err
	}
	var raw []byte
	var digest, storedInstanceID, storedStudentID string
	err := repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT assistance.receipt,assistance.command_digest,assistance.task_instance_id,assistance.student_id
FROM practice_assistance_receipts assistance
JOIN practice_task_instances instance ON instance.id=$2 AND instance.student_id=$3
WHERE assistance.usage_id=$1`, usageID, instanceID, studentID).Scan(&raw, &digest, &storedInstanceID, &storedStudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", translateError(err)
	}
	if storedInstanceID != instanceID || storedStudentID != studentID {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", domain.ErrIdempotency
	}
	var receipt ports.AssistanceReceipt
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &receipt); err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", err
	}
	return receipt, digest, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) RecordAssistance(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, receipt ports.AssistanceReceipt, commandDigest string) (domain.TaskInstance, ports.AssistanceReceipt, bool, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	if receipt.Schema != "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1" || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.UsageID) || receipt.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID || receipt.StudentID != instance.StudentID ||
		!validDigest(commandDigest) || receipt.OccurredAt.IsZero() || receipt.PolicyVersion != instance.AssistancePolicyVersion ||
		receipt.Kind != "HINT" && receipt.Kind != "TEACHER_QUESTION" && receipt.Kind != "TEACHER_EXPLANATION" ||
		receipt.Kind == "HINT" && (receipt.HintLevel < 1 || receipt.HintLevel > 7) ||
		receipt.Kind != "HINT" && receipt.HintLevel != 0 {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	current, err := instanceForUpdate(ctx, tx, instance.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	// This authorization also covers callers racing between lookup and commit.
	if current.StudentID != receipt.StudentID || current.StudentID != instance.StudentID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	var oldDigest string
	var oldRaw []byte
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT command_digest,receipt FROM practice_assistance_receipts WHERE usage_id=$1`, receipt.UsageID).Scan(&oldDigest, &oldRaw)
	if err == nil {
		var existing ports.AssistanceReceipt
		if json.Unmarshal(oldRaw, &existing) != nil || oldDigest != commandDigest || !existing.SameCommand(receipt) || existing.PolicyVersion == "" || existing.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
			return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		return current, existing, false, tx.Commit()
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	if current.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress || current.LearningActionID == "" || receipt.Kind == "HINT" && current.HintsUsed >= 1000 {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	stepExists := false
	for _, step := range current.Steps {
		if step.ID == receipt.StepID {
			stepExists = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !stepExists {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	encodedReceipt, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_assistance_receipts(usage_id,task_instance_id,student_id,command_digest,receipt,created_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6)`, receipt.UsageID, instance.ID, instance.StudentID, commandDigest, encodedReceipt, receipt.OccurredAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, translateError(err)
	}
	if receipt.Kind == "HINT" {
		current.HintsUsed++
		if current.MaxHintLevel == nil || receipt.HintLevel > *current.MaxHintLevel {
			value := receipt.HintLevel
			current.MaxHintLevel = &value
		}
	}
	current.TeacherAssistanceUsed = true
	current.AssistancePolicyVersion = receipt.PolicyVersion
	if receipt.OccurredAt.After(current.UpdatedAt) {
		current.UpdatedAt = receipt.OccurredAt.UTC()
	}
	current.Version++
	encodedInstance, err := marshalInstance(current)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_task_instances SET version=$2,payload=$3::jsonb,updated_at=$4 WHERE id=$1 AND version=$5`,
		current.ID, current.Version, encodedInstance, current.UpdatedAt, current.Version-1)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, translateError(err)
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, err
	}
	return current, receipt, true, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) CreateOrLoadCommandReceipt(ctx context.Context, idempotencyKey, taskInstanceID, commandType, commandDigest string) (bool, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(taskInstanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(idempotencyKey) || commandType == "" || !validDigest(commandDigest) {
		return false, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	result, err := repository.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_command_receipts(task_instance_id,command_type,idempotency_key,command_digest)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT (task_instance_id,command_type,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING`, taskInstanceID, commandType, idempotencyKey, commandDigest)
	if err != nil {
		return false, translateError(err)
	}
	affected, err := result.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if affected == 1 {
		return true, nil
	}
	var stored string
	err = repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT command_digest FROM practice_command_receipts
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND command_type=$2 AND idempotency_key=$3`, taskInstanceID, commandType, idempotencyKey).Scan(&stored)
	if err != nil {
		return false, translateError(err)
	}
	if stored != commandDigest {
		return false, domain.ErrIdempotency
	}
	return false, nil
}

func (repository *Repository) PendingValidationRuns(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]ports.PendingValidation, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	cutoff := time.Now().UTC().Add(-validationLease)
	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT run.id,run.payload FROM practice_validation_runs AS run
JOIN practice_submissions AS submission ON submission.id=run.submission_id AND submission.current_run_id=run.id
JOIN practice_task_instances AS instance ON instance.id=run.task_instance_id AND instance.current_submission_id=submission.id
WHERE run.status='RUNNING' AND run.started_at <= $1 AND submission.status='VALIDATING' AND instance.status='VALIDATING'
FOR UPDATE OF run SKIP LOCKED`, cutoff)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	type staleRun struct {
		id  string
		raw []byte
	}
	stale := make([]staleRun, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item staleRun
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.id, &item.raw); err != nil {
			_ = rows.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		stale = append(stale, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		_ = rows.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := rows.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, item := range stale {
		var run domain.ValidationRun
		if err := json.Unmarshal(item.raw, &run); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode stale ValidationRun: %w", err)
		}
		run.Status, run.StartedAt, run.FinishedAt, run.Outcome, run.ErrorClassification = domain.ValidationRunPending, nil, nil, "", ""
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(run)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_validation_runs SET status='PENDING',outcome=NULL,error_classification=NULL,started_at=NULL,finished_at=NULL,payload=$2::jsonb,updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1`, item.id, encoded, time.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return nil, translateError(err)
		}
	}
	selectRows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT run.task_instance_id,run.submission_id,run.id,instance.student_id
FROM practice_validation_runs AS run
JOIN practice_submissions AS submission ON submission.id=run.submission_id AND submission.current_run_id=run.id
JOIN practice_task_instances AS instance ON instance.id=run.task_instance_id
WHERE run.status='PENDING' AND submission.status='VALIDATING' AND instance.current_submission_id=submission.id AND instance.status='VALIDATING'
ORDER BY run.created_at,run.id LIMIT $1`, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]ports.PendingValidation, 0, limit)
	for selectRows.Next() {
		var item ports.PendingValidation
		if err := selectRows.Scan(&item.TaskInstanceID, &item.SubmissionID, &item.RunID, &item.StudentID); err != nil {
			_ = selectRows.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	if err := selectRows.Err(); err != nil {
		_ = selectRows.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := selectRows.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}
